answer: I'm sorry for your loss. To sell a car you inherited, bring your father's death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, either the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1, and any power of attorney he signed ended at his death, so it can't be used. If there's still a loan on the car, the lender holds the title; if it's paid off and the title is lost, you'll need a duplicate title from the state before we can complete the purchase.
